title: On the Legendrian invariant in knot lattice homology
summary: The Ozsváth-Szabó contact invariant $c^+(ξ)\in\mathrm{HF}^+(-Y)$ of the link of a normal surface singularity equipped with its canonical contact structure $(Y,ξ)$ was transposed to lattice homology theory by Bodnár-Plamenevskaya. When considering a transverse algebraic knot $L$ in the link, the chain complex computing $\mathrm{HF}^+(-Y)$ can be equipped with an Alexander grading, and we can define an element $\mathcal{L}(L)$ in the bigraded theory $\mathrm{HFK}^+(-Y,L)$, which maps to the contact element by forgetting the filtration.
